main.description: Sets the complete set of roles a member holds.

community.description: The community the member belongs to.

subject.description: The member whose roles are being set.

roles.description: The complete new set of roles the member should hold.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the role.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: MemberNotFound
errors.description: The subject does not hold a member record in this community.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: One of the requested roles does not exist.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The requesting user cannot grant or revoke a role at or above their own highest position.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.
